1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Enter a three character code on 12 large keys. Shallow 3D motion begins after the second character and completes in 14 to 16 seconds.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Enter a four character code on 20 keys. Partial 3D motion begins after the first character and completes in 12 to 14 seconds.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Enter a five character code on 26 keys. Full 3D motion begins after the first character and completes in 10.5 to 12 seconds.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Enter a five character code on the current 32 key layout. Full 3D motion begins after the first character and completes in 8.8 to 10 seconds.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Enter an eight character code on 32 smaller keys. Variable 3D motion starts immediately and completes in 5.5 to 7 seconds.
